From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Paul Chen <paul.chen@brightwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-02-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor activation: BrightWave (PO flow + invoice delivery)

Hi Paul — welcome, and thanks for the details. Quick responses below plus a couple of attachments to speed onboarding.

1) Channel preference: portal-first. For any invoice tied to a PO we ask vendors to use our vendor portal (preferred) because it gives automatic PO matching, ACK receipts, and reduces manual exceptions. For partners who cannot use the portal we allow an email fallback but it must follow the subject and filename conventions below.

2) Email fallback requirements (if portal not possible):
   - Send to: ap-invoices@redwood.com
   - Subject MUST include: PO:<PO_NUMBER> (example: PO:4872)
   - Filename MUST include: vendorname_PO<PO_NUMBER>_YYYYMMDD.pdf (example: BrightWave_PO4872_20280315.pdf)

3) Mandatory fields for PO-matching:
   - PO number (visible on first page)
   - Line item descriptions + unit price + qty + line-level total
   - Invoice total and tax breakdown if applicable
   - Billing entity (which Redwood legal entity to bill)

I attached our vendor onboarding form (Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and a compact CSV template (sample_template_redwood.csv) showing the minimal line-item fields we ingest for automated match. If BrightWave can map your export to that CSV, our portal will automatically attach invoice lines to the PO and minimize manual review.

If you want to use the email fallback, confirm the address you will send from and we can whitelist it to avoid spam filtering. If you prefer the portal I can send an invite once your onboarding form is returned.

Next steps:
- Paul: complete and return the onboarding form (I can accept signed PDF)
- Paul: confirm which channel you prefer (portal or email fallback)
- Vanessa: I will loop you on whitelist / invite depending on Paul's answer

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
[attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, sample_template_redwood.csv]

Marissa — forwarding the thread from BrightWave. Summary and recommended path below.

Summary: BrightWave will be onboarded as a vendor. PO 4872 is expected; vendor prefers email fallback for the first cycle and will move to portal later. They will send one PDF per PO and will use the subject token PO:4872 and the filename pattern we requested. They also attached a sample invoice for validation.

Recommendation (internal action):
- Approve email-fallback for BrightWave for the first invoice only (portal preferred thereafter).
- AP to whitelist billing@brightwave.com and ensure ap-invoices@redwood.com is monitoring for subject-token PO:4872 to enable auto-match.
- Confirm which Redwood legal entity should appear on the invoice (we should default to Redwood Inference, Inc. — please confirm if AP needs a different entity).
- If AP approves, mark vendor record with: "EmailFallbackAllowed: true; FallbackPolicy: single-PDF-per-PO; RequiredSubjectToken: PO:<number>"

Notes: The vendor's sample PDF looks fine for basic PO matching; however, it is missing a line-level SKU column which would help automated matching later. Recommend we accept the PDF for this first invoice and ask vendor to include SKU or provide CSV mapping for future cycles.

Vanessa — please prepare a portal invite and the whitelist steps. If AP approves email fallback, please confirm the confirmation ACK text we send back to vendors (I typically send: "Invoice received and queued for PO matching — we'll follow up on exceptions within 3 business days").

Marissa — can you confirm the legal entity to appear on invoice and whether AP is comfortable with the one-off email fallback? Once you confirm I will send BrightWave the onboarding form and either the portal invite or whitelist confirmation.

Thanks,
Soojin
